import { motion, useReducedMotion, useReducedMotionConfig } from 'motion/react'
import { useId, type ElementType, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

/** OS setting, or forced on with <MotionConfig reducedMotion="always">. */
function usePrefersReducedMotion() {
  const os = useReducedMotion()
  const forced = useReducedMotionConfig()
  return Boolean(os || forced)
}

export interface FeatureIconGridItem {
  /** Short name of the feature. */
  title: string
  /** One or two sentences. */
  description: ReactNode
  /** Decorative icon shown in a tile above the title. */
  icon?: ReactNode
}

export interface FeaturesIconGridProps {
  /** Section headline. Labels the section for assistive tech. */
  title: ReactNode
  /** Copy under the headline. */
  description?: ReactNode
  /** Small pill above the headline. */
  eyebrow?: ReactNode
  /** The features, laid out as cards. */
  features: FeatureIconGridItem[]
  /** Columns on wide containers. Two on medium containers, one on narrow ones. */
  columns?: 2 | 3 | 4
  /** Element for the headline. */
  titleAs?: ElementType
  /** Element for the root. */
  as?: ElementType
  /** Seconds each card takes to fade in. */
  duration?: number
  /** Seconds between cards. */
  stagger?: number
  /** Turns the entrance animation off. */
  disabled?: boolean
  className?: string
}

const columnClass = {
  2: '@2xl:grid-cols-2',
  3: '@2xl:grid-cols-2 @4xl:grid-cols-3',
  4: '@2xl:grid-cols-2 @4xl:grid-cols-4',
} as const

/** A headline over a grid of icon cards that rise in one after another. */
export function FeaturesIconGrid({
  title,
  description,
  eyebrow,
  features,
  columns = 3,
  titleAs: Title = 'h2',
  as: Tag = 'section',
  duration = 0.5,
  stagger = 0.06,
  disabled = false,
  className,
}: FeaturesIconGridProps) {
  const id = useId()
  const reduced = usePrefersReducedMotion()
  const animate = !disabled && !reduced

  return (
    <Tag aria-labelledby={id} className={cn('@container w-full', className)}>
      <div className="mx-auto mb-12 flex max-w-2xl flex-col items-center gap-4 text-center">
        {eyebrow != null && (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border bg-muted/50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
            <span aria-hidden className="size-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary" />
            {eyebrow}
          </span>
        )}
        <Title id={id} className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-balance text-foreground @xl:text-4xl">
          {title}
        </Title>
        {description != null && <p className="text-base leading-relaxed text-pretty text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>}
      </div>
      <ul className={cn('grid grid-cols-1 gap-4', columnClass[columns])}>
        {features.map((feature, i) => (
          <motion.li
            key={feature.title}
            initial={animate ? { opacity: 0, y: 20 } : false}
            whileInView={animate ? { opacity: 1, y: 0 } : undefined}
            viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-60px' }}
            transition={{ duration, delay: i * stagger, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
            className="group/feature rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground transition-[translate,box-shadow] duration-300 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-foreground/5 motion-safe:hover:-translate-y-1"
          >
            {feature.icon != null && (
              <span
                aria-hidden
                className="mb-4 inline-flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary [&_svg]:size-5"
              >
                {feature.icon}
              </span>
            )}
            <h3 className="mb-2 text-base font-semibold text-foreground">{feature.title}</h3>
            <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{feature.description}</p>
          </motion.li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </Tag>
  )
}

// Source: educlopez/smoothui (MIT) — https://github.com/educlopez/smoothui/blob/main/packages/smoothui/blocks/features/features-1/index.tsx
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { FeaturesIconGrid } from '@/components/features-icon-grid'

const Icon = ({ d }: { d: string }): ReactNode => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
    <path d={d} />
  </svg>
)

const features = [
  { title: 'Lightning fast', description: 'Optimized for performance with a tiny bundle and efficient rendering.', icon: <Icon d="m3.75 13.5 10.5-11.25L12 10.5h8.25L9.75 21.75 12 13.5H3.75z" /> },
  { title: 'Accessible', description: 'ARIA attributes, keyboard navigation and reduced motion support built in.', icon: <Icon d="M12 3a9 9 0 1 0 0 18 9 9 0 0 0 0-18zm0 5v5m0 3v.01" /> },
  { title: 'Customizable', description: 'Tailwind classes and design tokens let you restyle anything in minutes.', icon: <Icon d="M4 7h10m4 0h2M4 17h2m4 0h10M14 4v6m-4 4v6" /> },
  { title: 'TypeScript first', description: 'Exported types for every prop, so your editor does the documenting.', icon: <Icon d="M17.25 6.75 22.5 12l-5.25 5.25m-10.5 0L1.5 12l5.25-5.25m7.5-3-4.5 16.5" /> },
  { title: 'Smooth motion', description: 'Spring animations with sensible defaults and a calm reduced-motion mode.', icon: <Icon d="M12 3v4m0 10v4M3 12h4m10 0h4M6 6l2.5 2.5m7 7L18 18M18 6l-2.5 2.5m-7 7L6 18" /> },
  { title: 'Open source', description: 'Copy the source into your project with one command and own every line.', icon: <Icon d="M21 8.25c0-2.485-2.099-4.5-4.688-4.5-1.935 0-3.597 1.126-4.312 2.733-.715-1.607-2.377-2.733-4.313-2.733C5.1 3.75 3 5.765 3 8.25c0 7.22 9 12 9 12s9-4.78 9-12z" /> },
]

export default function FeaturesIconGridDemo() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl">
      <FeaturesIconGrid
        eyebrow="Features"
        title="Everything you need to build"
        description="Production-ready pieces with motion, accessibility and types included."
        features={features}
      />
    </div>
  )
}
